**Likely function:** This 499-amino-acid protein is strongly supported as a **MurE ligase**, an enzyme in bacterial peptidoglycan (cell-wall) biosynthesis. Its closest reviewed match is *Pseudomonas aeruginosa* MurE (49.8% identity across 96.8% of the sequence; E-value 4.03 × 10⁻¹³⁰).

MurE uses ATP to add **meso-diaminopimelate** to the peptidoglycan precursor UMAG, producing a downstream cell-wall precursor. The reference enzyme is Mg²⁺-dependent (EC 6.3.2.13) and cytosolic; these annotations are inferred for this sequence from homology, not experimentally verified for the supplied protein.
